System operations for health checks, validation, and maintenance.

This command group provides operations for system-level management:
  Common operations: check (object health and compliance), align (strategic alignment)
  Specialized operations: init, status, validate, sync

  Common operations
  zqk system check
  Strategic alignment
  zqk system align --gaps
  Specialized operations
  zqk system init
  Show status
  zqk system status
  Validate objects
  zqk system validate
  Sync system
  zqk system sync

Usage:
  zqk system [command]

Available Commands:
  agent-onboard                  Detect agent hosts, seed seating, and sync workspace↔kernel directives
  align                          Validate strategic alignment (goal-work alignment)
  ambient-daemon                 Generated spec for ambient-daemon
  audit-milestones               Audit milestone associations for backlog items
  audit-report                   Generate audit report from command metrics
  audit-stream                   Stream real-time audit events
  check                          Check object health: registration, lifecycle, and policy compliance
  clean-branches                 Prune stale merged feature branches locally and remotely
  cleanup-duplicates             Clean up duplicate traditional files that have hash-based equivalents
  compact-journal                Compact change journal entries into dictionary-compressed artifacts
  dashboard                      dashboard command
  disk-usage                     Report directory sizes (cross-platform du-style scan)
  emergency-manager              Monitors the health of the CAP orchestrator and Kernel Steward. Executes safe rollbacks or stashes untracked files if the main managers fail continuously.
  ensure-retention-jobs          Ensure maintenance bundle scheduler jobs exist (retention, audit, cache_prewarm, autofix, etc.)
  evolve                         evolve command
  federate                       federate command
  fswatcher-daemon               Start the FSWatcher daemon
  improvement-report             Generate system improvement report with comparative analysis and prioritized work items
  init                           Initialize a new ZQK project
  kernel-integrity               Kernel Mutation Pipeline coverage and dangling-ref heal
  materialize-agent-chat-channel Materialize agent_chat_channel lite file from a CAS agent_feed
  metrics                        View command execution metrics and statistics
  migrate-cas                    Migrate legacy UUID identities to deterministic CAS hashes
  object-count-report            Generated spec for object-count-report
  object-hygiene-scan            Generated spec for object-hygiene-scan
  orchestrate-batch              Generates the ontological cascade (Workstream, Requirement, Criteria, TestCase) for a batch of items
  policy-interrupts              Generated spec for policy-interrupts
  prompt-builder                 Builds a topologically sorted context window prompt using the Vectorization Engine
  rebuild-graph-projection       Rebuild MemGraph projection from file SSOT
  recover-cas                    Recover CAS objects with missing files
  repair-cas-corruption          Repair CAS filename/content hash mismatches (Tier-1 integrity blockers)
  retention-tolerance            Run retention tolerance (archive and cleanup by age and max_count)
  seal-skill                     Generate or verify the cryptographic seal for a skill pack
  seed-default-agent-seating     Idempotent seed of PER-DEFAULT-* personas and feed correspondence skill
  semantic-bridge-daemon         Generated spec for semantic-bridge-daemon
  snapshot                       Capture a sanitized telemetry snapshot for partner support
  snapshot-expand                Expand a compressed snapshot file
  snapshot-scenario              Capture system state snapshot for test scenario creation
  snapshot-verify                Verify compressed snapshot data integrity against live objects
  spec-origination               Originate a complete object-kind membrane
  start-here                     Start Here tutorial for new users and agents
  state-commit                   Commit the Knowledge Kernel state into a single compressed artifact
  state-diff                     Compare two system state snapshots or a snapshot against live state
  state-restore                  Restore the Knowledge Kernel state from a compressed artifact
  status                         Show system status and health summary
  stream-gc                      Run garbage collector to prune orphaned JSONL stream segment files
  sync                           Sync objects between backends or environments
  sync-cas-index                 Sync CAS index from an existing hash-addressed file
  sync-git-hooks                 Sync git hook templates to a git hooks directory
  telemetry                      View telemetry from running agent tasks
  truth-sentinel                 Run the Truth Sentinel daemon
  update-specs                   Bulk update object specifications
  validate                       Validate object(s) against schema
  validate-agent-rules           Validate IDE agent rules manifest vs rules directory
  validate-command-specs         Validate live CLI commands against canonical command specs
  validate-scenario              Execute a programmatic validation scenario
  whoami                         Show the authenticated account, lane, roles, and permissions

Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system [command] --help" for more information about a command.
